Profile a data frame

Source: R/profile.R
profile_data.Rd

Writes d to an in-memory SQLite database and profiles it with profile_query(). Use it to profile data that is already in R.

Usage

profile_data(d, field_types, ...)

Arguments

d

A data frame that holds every column of field_types.

field_types

A named character vector of csdb field types, as in profile_query(). Columns of d that it does not name are not written.

...

Other arguments to profile_query(). Do not give connection, sql or field_types.

Value

A csdb_profile, as profile_query() returns it. The query selects every column of the in-memory table profile_data.

See also

Other profile functions: profile_query(), profile_table(), read_profile(), write_profile()

Examples

d <- data.frame(
  day = as.Date("2024-01-01") + rep(0:3, each = 5),
  cases = rep(c(2L, 7L, 9L, 12L), each = 5)
)
p <- profile_data(
  d,
  field_types = c(day = "DATE", cases = "INTEGER"),
  columns = c(day = "full", cases = "full")
)
p$columns$day
#> $type
#> [1] "DATE"
#> 
#> $sensitivity
#> [1] "full"
#> 
#> $missing_share
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $days
#> [1] "2024-01-01" "2024-01-02" "2024-01-03" "2024-01-04"
#> 
#> $n
#> [1] 5 5 5 5
#>
